areas.name: The Gilded Ace
areas.place: In the shadows of the tavern

areas.name: The Cellar
areas.place: In the damp dark of the cellar

intro.title: A summons from the King
intro.text: A royal rider gallops into the Gilded Ace. "Sir Edward! The Frost Giant has stolen the King's Frost Crown. Without it, winter will never end."

intro.title: Into the snow
intro.text: Anna presses a warm cloak into your hands. "Come back to us, Sir Edward." You ride north, where the mountains are white and the wind howls like wolves.

a1.title: The Ice Caves
a1.text: The Yeti Chieftain falls in the snow. Huge footprints lead into a cave that glitters like a thousand blue diamonds.

a2.title: The Frozen Lake
a2.text: Beyond the caves lies a frozen lake. On the far shore, the Frost Giant's hall smokes with blue fire.

a3.title: The Giant's Hall
a3.text: The Frost Wyrm sinks beneath the ice. The doors of the Giant's hall stand open, and from inside comes a laugh like an avalanche.

end.title: The crown returns
end.text: The Frost Giant crashes down like a falling mountain. You lift the Frost Crown from the snow, and the clouds begin to part.

end.title: Spring comes
end.text: The King places the crown on his head and warm wind sweeps the land. "Rest well, Sir Edward. I fear we will need you again soon."

worlds.name: The Burning Sands

intro.title: A cry for help
intro.text: A caravan carrying the kingdom's medicine has vanished in the Burning Sands. The last message says only: "The dead walk at night."

intro.title: The endless desert
intro.text: You cross the dunes under a blazing sun. Far away, half buried in sand, stands an ancient pyramid.

a1.title: The Oasis Ruins
a1.text: From inside the Sand Wyrm's coils you pull a torn caravan flag. Its trail leads to an old oasis in ruins.

a2.title: The Pyramid
a2.text: The Djinn vanishes in smoke and leaves behind a golden key. It fits the great door of the pyramid.

a3.title: The Sun Temple
a3.text: The Pharaoh crumbles to dust. Through a hidden passage you climb toward the Sun Temple, where the merchants are chained.

end.title: The caravan is free
end.text: The Scorched King falls and the flames go out. You break the merchants' chains, and they weep with joy.

end.title: Medicine for the kingdom
end.text: The caravan rolls home with its medicine. Children cheer as Sir Edward rides beside the wagons.

steps: They lead deeper into the desert
The caravan is held at the top

worlds.name: The Sunken Coast

intro.title: Ships are vanishing
intro.text: Every ship that sails past the Sunken Coast disappears. Fishermen whisper about a giant bell ringing under the waves.

intro.title: To the coast
intro.text: You sail out on a fishing boat. Fog rolls in, and somewhere below the water, a bell begins to toll.

a1.title: The Shipwreck
a1.text: Captain Blacktide's map shows a wreck below the cove. You drink a sea-witch's potion, take a deep breath and dive.

a2.title: The Coral Depths
a2.text: Past the ghost ship, the sea floor opens into a forest of glowing coral. The bell's toll shakes the water.

a3.title: The Drowned Temple
a3.text: The Sea Serpent sinks into the dark. Ahead lies a temple, and inside it a giant bronze bell wrapped in tentacles.

end.title: The bell falls silent
end.text: The Kraken lets go and sinks into the deep. You cut the bell's chain, and the sea goes calm and still.

end.title: Safe waters
end.text: Ships sail the coast again. The fishermen name their best boat the Sir Edward.

steps: End the curse of the coast

worlds.name: The Plague Marsh

intro.title: A sickness spreads
intro.text: A green fog drifts out of the Plague Marsh, and everyone it touches falls ill. An old healer begs for help: "Someone is brewing the curse."

intro.title: Into the fog
intro.text: You wrap a cloth over your face and wade into the marsh. The trees are dead and the water bubbles.

a1.title: The Plague Village
a1.text: The Croc sinks into the muck. Beyond the reeds, an empty village sits on stilts, its lanterns still burning.

a2.title: The Witch's Bog
a2.text: In the Plague Beast's den you find empty potion jars, all marked with the same witch's sign. It points to the bog.

a3.title: The Hag's Lair
a3.text: The Bog Troll falls with a splash. Inside a giant rotting tree, a green cauldron bubbles, and a cackle echoes.

end.title: The cauldron breaks
end.text: The Bog Hag shrieks and melts into the mud. You kick over her cauldron, and the green fog drains away.

end.title: The healing
end.text: The sick wake up healthy. The old healer bows. "The whole kingdom owes you its life, Sir Edward."

steps: Someone left a trail of potions

intro.title: The forge goes cold
intro.text: The dwarves of the Iron Mines have sent no iron for months. A wounded dwarf crawls into the castle: "The golems woke up... they took the Great Forge!"

intro.title: Into the mountain
intro.text: You light a lantern and step into the mine. Deep below, something heavy goes thump... thump... thump.

a1.title: The Crystal Cavern
a1.text: The Foreman drops a map scratched on leather. It shows a cavern full of crystals where the dwarves were taken.

a2.title: The Lava Tunnels
a2.text: Beyond the Drake's nest, the air turns hot. Rivers of lava light the way down to the Great Forge.

a3.title: The Great Forge
a3.text: The Lava Golem crumbles. Through the doors you see the dwarves chained to the anvils, and a giant made of iron.

end.title: The forge burns again
end.text: The Iron Golem crashes down. The dwarves break free and light the Great Forge with a mighty cheer.

end.title: A gift of steel
end.text: The dwarf king hands you a shield marked with your name. "No finer knight ever walked our halls, Sir Edward."

worlds.name: The Haunted Abbey

intro.title: The bells stop
intro.text: The bells of the Holy Abbey have gone silent, and the monks have not been seen in weeks. At night, candles flicker in every window.

intro.title: The abbey gates
intro.text: The gates creak open on their own. A cold voice whispers your name: "Edwaaard..."

a1.title: The Cloister
a1.text: The Headless Knight falls apart. A key on a black ribbon opens the abbey door, and the cold voice laughs inside.

a2.title: The Catacombs
a2.text: The Abbot sobs as the curse leaves him. "The Lich... he hides below, in the bones."

a3.title: The Bell Tower
a3.text: The Bone Dragon collapses into a pile of bones. Far above, in the tower, a green light pulses where the bells should ring.

end.title: The bells ring
end.text: The Lich shatters into dust. You pull the great rope, and the bells ring out across the land for the first time in weeks.

end.title: Peace returns
end.text: The monks return, whole again. They carve your name in the abbey wall: Sir Edward, the Bell-Ringer.

steps: The monks were last seen here

worlds.name: The Elven Wilds

intro.title: The forest turns dark
intro.text: The peaceful elves of the Wilds have stopped trading. Travelers come back covered in thorns, whispering about a queen with a heart of briars.

intro.title: The silver forest
intro.text: The trees of the Wilds shine like silver, but black thorns are choking them. Elven eyes watch you from the branches.

a1.title: The Moonlit Glade
a1.text: The Briar Bear falls and the thorns pull back. A small elf girl peeks out from behind a tree. "Please... help our queen."

a2.title: The Elven City
a2.text: The Dark Unicorn's horn cracks, and its red glow fades. The elf girl leads you to a city in the trees, wrapped in thorns.

a3.title: The Heart Tree
a3.text: The Thorn General kneels, freed from the spell. "The queen took the Heart of the Forest. Save her... from herself."

end.title: The heart is free
end.text: The thorns crumble from the Queen's crown. She opens her eyes, and they are kind again. "What have I done?"

end.title: Friends of the forest
end.text: The silver trees bloom. The Elf Queen gives you a leaf of pure silver. "The elves will always stand with Sir Edward."

steps: The thorns spread from the city
The elves are under a spell

worlds.name: The Sky Fortress

intro.title: A storm that never ends
intro.text: Lightning strikes the kingdom every night, and a fortress has appeared floating in the clouds. The King's wizard says: "The Storm Titan has awoken."

intro.title: Up to the clouds
intro.text: The wizard's spell lifts you on a staircase of wind. Up and up you climb, into the storm.

a1.title: The Sky Gardens
a1.text: The Griffon King bows his golden head and lets you ride on his back to the floating gardens.

a2.title: The Fortress Walls
a2.text: The Storm Drake falls into the clouds. Before you rise the huge walls of the Sky Fortress, crackling with lightning.

a3.title: The Storm Throne
a3.text: The Storm Giant topples off the walls. At the very top, on a throne of lightning, the Titan opens his eyes.

end.title: The storm breaks
end.text: The Titan roars and fades into a harmless cloud. Sunlight pours over the fortress for the first time in a hundred years.

end.title: A dark warning
end.text: In the empty throne you find a black letter: "You cannot stop me forever. Come to the Abyss, Sir Edward." It is signed with a burning crown.

steps: Find a way into the fortress
The throne is at the top

intro.title: The final quest
intro.text: The letter burns away in your hands. Every monster you ever fought was sent by one master: the Demon King, who waits in the Abyss.

intro.title: The gates of the Abyss
intro.text: Anna, Old Bram, the King and all your friends see you off. You step through the burning gates into darkness.

a1.title: The Chained Halls
a1.text: Cerberus whimpers and runs off. Below, you hear the rattle of chains and the cries of the Demon King's prisoners.

a2.title: The Lake of Fire
a2.text: With the Warden's keys you free the prisoners. They point across a lake of fire to a castle of black glass.

a3.title: The Demon Throne
a3.text: The Flame Fiend sinks into the lake. The doors of the black castle open, and a voice like thunder says: "At last, Sir Edward."

end.title: The Demon King falls
end.text: With one last mighty hand, the Demon King crashes from his throne. His burning crown rolls to your feet and goes dark.

end.title: Legend of Sir Edward
end.text: The whole kingdom celebrates for a week. Anna, Old Bram and the King raise their cups: "To Sir Edward, the greatest hero who ever lived!"

end.title: But the darkness stirs...
end.text: Deep in the Abyss, the shadows gather again. New monsters rise, stronger than ever. The Endless Quest begins.

blocks.name: Sneaky Goblin
blocks.desc: Knee-high, mean, and far too pleased with itself. It fights dirty because fighting fair has never once worked for it.
blocks.tactics: Opens from cover, stabs whoever looks softest, and runs the moment the fight stops being funny.

blocks.name: Giant Rat
blocks.desc: A rat the size of a dog, raised on cellar scraps and spite. There is never only one.
blocks.tactics: Swarms the nearest ankle. Loses interest if something bigger starts bleeding.

blocks.name: Tavern Bat
blocks.desc: It lives in the tavern rafters and resents company. All leather and teeth and bad temper.
blocks.tactics: Dives, bites an ear, and is back in the dark before anyone swings.

blocks.name: Wild Boar
blocks.desc: Someone let a boar into the tavern. It has knocked over three tables and is not finished.
blocks.tactics: Picks a target, lowers its head, and does not change its mind.

blocks.name: Little Imp
blocks.desc: A hand-sized devil with a grin it has not earned. It is here because somebody summoned it and then lost interest.
blocks.tactics: Stays airborne, stings, and licks the wound to mend its own.

blocks.name: Bandit Chief
blocks.desc: The one giving the orders, and the only one in the room who has thought past tonight. He took Anna because she was worth something to someone.
blocks.tactics: Keeps a table between himself and you, lets his men tire you out, then opens up with everything at once.

blocks.name: Rattling Skeleton
blocks.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak
blocks.desc: Held together by old string and worse magic. It rattles when it walks, which is the only warning you get.
blocks.tactics: Comes straight on. A good hammer blow takes most of it apart at once.

blocks.name: Giant Spider
blocks.desc: Big enough to need the whole corner of the cellar for its web. It has been waiting a long time.
blocks.tactics: Drops from the ceiling, bites, and backs off to let the poison work.

blocks.name: Cellar Snake
blocks.desc: It came up through the cellar drain and decided to stay. Patient, quiet, and quicker than it looks.
blocks.tactics: Holds still until something comes close, then strikes once and withdraws.

blocks.name: Lost Zombie
blocks.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak
blocks.desc: Slow, dim, and very hard to put down for good. It was somebody once and nobody has had the decency to say who.
blocks.tactics: Walks at you until it reaches you. Keeps getting back up.

blocks.name: Giant Scorpion
blocks.desc: All shell and no sense. The tail is the part to watch, and it knows it.
blocks.tactics: Grabs with the claws so the sting cannot miss.

blocks.name: Cellar Ghoul
blocks.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak
blocks.desc: It has been down here with the barrels long enough to forget bread. It is the reason the cellar door was locked from the outside.
blocks.tactics: Pins one person and feeds while the rest of the fight happens around it.

blocks.name: Dire Wolf
blocks.desc: Lean, grey, and hungry enough to try a road with four armed people on it. It is not working alone.
blocks.tactics: Circles for position and only commits once something else has your attention.

blocks.name: Swamp Witch
blocks.desc: She lives where the trees close over the path and charges a price nobody wants to pay twice. Still polite about it.
blocks.tactics: Keeps her distance, mends herself first, and saves the worst of it for whoever is nearly down.

blocks.name: Angry Bear
blocks.desc: A bear having a bad week. You are in its wood and it has explained that twice already.
blocks.tactics: One enormous swing, then another. No plan beyond that.

blocks.name: Treant
blocks.desc: An old tree that got tired of being walked past. It moves about as fast as you would expect and hits considerably harder.
blocks.tactics: Stands its ground, swings both limbs, and heals in the sun.

blocks.name: Giant Toad
blocks.desc: A toad the size of a cart horse. It swallows things whole and regrets nothing.
blocks.tactics: Leaps the gap, bites, and tries to get the smallest of you inside its mouth.

blocks.name: Troll King
blocks.desc: King of a wood with no other trolls in it, which has never troubled him. Cut him and it closes over while you watch.
blocks.tactics: Wades in, takes the hits, and waits for your fire to run out.

blocks.name: Dark Knight
blocks.desc: Grimstone's man at arms, in armor nobody has polished in years. He does not talk and he does not stop.
blocks.tactics: Fights properly: guards, waits for an opening, and puts everything into one blow.

blocks.name: Stone Gargoyle
res: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine
blocks.desc: It sat on the parapet for a hundred years looking like masonry. It was counting.
blocks.tactics: Holds still until you walk under it, then drops.

blocks.name: Castle Ghost
res: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
blocks.desc: Something that died in this hall and has not accepted the news. It goes through walls and takes its time.
blocks.tactics: Steps out of the stone, frightens whoever is closest, and drains the one who runs.

blocks.name: Vampire
res: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
blocks.desc: Well dressed, well spoken, and entirely finished with being polite about dinner. Keep it away from the windows and it never tires.
blocks.tactics: Grapples the weakest of you and feeds. Will not follow you into daylight.

blocks.name: Baby Dragon
blocks.desc: Dog-sized, bad-tempered, and already convinced the castle is its own. The fire works perfectly well.
blocks.tactics: Stays out of reach, bites, and empties its lungs at whoever bunched up.

blocks.name: Grimstone Dragon
blocks.desc: The reason Castle Grimstone has no roof left on the tower. It has Anna, it knows exactly why you came, and it is in no hurry.
blocks.tactics: Fights from the air, lands only to bite, and burns the whole room when you spread out.

blocks.name: Ice Wolf
blocks.desc: White on white until it is already too close. The pack works the pass like a trade.
blocks.tactics: Drives you off the trail into deeper snow, then takes its time.

blocks.name: Snow Goblin
blocks.desc: Same goblin, worse weather, and a spear of hard ice it makes fresh every morning. Tougher than its cousins because the soft ones died.
blocks.tactics: Throws first from behind a drift, closes only when you are already busy.

blocks.name: Frost Bat
blocks.desc: It roosts in the pass and its bite leaves the skin white. You hear them before you see them.
blocks.tactics: Comes out of the dark in numbers, bites, and is gone.

blocks.name: Yeti Chieftain
blocks.desc: Head of whatever lives above the treeline, and the only thing up here that owns the weather. He watched you climb the whole way.
blocks.tactics: Lets the cold do half the work, plants himself across the path, and does not move for anything.

blocks.name: Ice Golem
blocks.desc: Ice shaped into arms and legs by something that is no longer in the cave. It has forgotten why it is standing there but not what to do about visitors.
blocks.tactics: Blocks the passage and sets itself. Fire is the short way through it.

blocks.name: Frost Spider
blocks.desc: Its web is frozen stiff across the cave mouth and rings like glass when you cut it. That is the doorbell.
blocks.tactics: Waits above, drops, bites, and lets the cold slow you down for the next one.

blocks.name: Ice Wraith
res: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
blocks.desc: The breath of someone who died up here, still looking for the way down. It is colder near it and the air does not warm back up.
blocks.tactics: Drifts through the ice wall, touches whoever is nearest, and takes the warmth with it.

blocks.name: The Ice Witch
blocks.desc: She keeps the caves the way she likes them and has had a long time to practice. Civil right up until she is not.
blocks.tactics: Opens by mending herself, freezes the ground under you, and never once closes the distance.

blocks.name: War Mammoth
blocks.desc: Shaggy, armored in its own hide, and wearing somebody's war harness. Whoever strapped it on is long gone.
blocks.tactics: Builds up speed across the flat ice and goes through whatever is in the way.

blocks.name: Ice Troll
blocks.desc: A troll that found somewhere even less pleasant to live. The cold keeps the wounds from showing and nothing stops them closing.
blocks.tactics: Takes the first round of damage on purpose to see what you have got.

blocks.name: Sabre Walrus
blocks.desc: Half a ton of blubber and two tusks it uses like crowbars. It owns this hole in the ice.
blocks.tactics: Comes up under the ice you are standing on and drags the nearest of you down.

blocks.name: Frost Wyrm
blocks.desc: It swims through the lake ice the way an eel swims through water. The cracking underfoot is not the weather.
blocks.tactics: Surfaces beneath the group, bites, and goes back under before you can answer.

blocks.name: Frost Knight
blocks.desc: Sworn to the Frost Giant and frozen into the job. The armor has not come off in a very long time.
blocks.tactics: Holds the doorway, parries the first real swing, and answers it properly.

blocks.name: Giant's Hound
blocks.desc: The Frost Giant keeps dogs, and they are sized to match. It has been fed just enough to stay interested.
blocks.tactics: Goes for whoever is standing apart from the group.

blocks.name: Frost Shaman
blocks.desc: He asks the mountain for weather and the mountain answers. That is most of his trick and it is enough.
blocks.tactics: Stays behind the knights, keeps them standing, and drops the ceiling's ice on whoever gets through.

blocks.name: The Frost Giant
blocks.desc: He took the King's Frost Crown because it was cold and it was pretty and nobody stopped him. He is wearing it now.
blocks.tactics: Two full swings a turn and a third that takes the floor with it. No guard, no retreat.

blocks.name: Sand Scorpion
blocks.desc: It spends the day under the sand and comes up through it. The shell turns most things you will swing at it.
blocks.tactics: Erupts under one of you, grabs with the claws, and stings until it lets go.

blocks.name: Bone Vulture
blocks.desc: It has been following you since the second dune and is in no rush. It does not need you dead, only slow.
blocks.tactics: Circles out of reach and only comes down for someone who has stopped moving.

blocks.name: Dune Raider
blocks.desc: He knows every well on this road and has poisoned two of them. The caravan paid him for safe passage last month.
blocks.tactics: Hits from the dune line and backs off before you can turn, over and over.

blocks.name: Sand Wyrm
blocks.desc: The caravan did not get lost. It went down, all at once, in one place, and the sand closed over the top.
blocks.tactics: Tracks you by footfall, comes up under the heaviest of you, and swallows what it can.

blocks.name: Jackal Warrior
blocks.desc: Jackal-headed, bronze-armored, and still standing guard over a temple that fell down centuries ago. The orders never got cancelled.
blocks.tactics: Fights in pairs and will not step off the ground it was told to hold.

blocks.name: Giant Cobra
blocks.desc: It rears to your chest height and spreads a hood the color of old brass. The venom is the whole argument.
blocks.tactics: Strikes once, hard, and gives the poison a turn to make its case.

blocks.name: Sand Golem
res: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
blocks.desc: Loose sand that holds a shape because something told it to. Blades go straight through and change nothing.
blocks.tactics: Pours back together after every hit and keeps walking.

blocks.name: The Dark Djinn
res: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
blocks.desc: Bound to the ruin and bitter about every year of it. It will offer you a deal and the deal is not good.
blocks.tactics: Stays in the air inside its own sandstorm, mends itself, and flays whoever will not take the bargain.

blocks.name: Ancient Mummy
blocks.languages: the languages it knew in life
res: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
blocks.desc: Wrapped, dry, and awake. It was put here with instructions and you are not on the list.
blocks.tactics: Walks you down, lands one withering blow, and takes back what the blow cost it.

blocks.name: Scarab Swarm King
blocks.desc: A crawling carpet of beetles with one big one in the middle doing the thinking. It fills the corridor.
blocks.tactics: Flows over and around you. Swords find very little to cut.

blocks.name: Tomb Guardian
blocks.languages: understands its maker's orders but can't speak
blocks.desc: Carved standing in the corner holding its hammer, and it has not moved since. It will.
blocks.tactics: Lets you walk past, then blocks the way back.

blocks.name: The Mummy Pharaoh
res: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
blocks.desc: He paid a great deal to never stop being king and the deal held. The crown is fused to the bone now.
blocks.tactics: Drains the strongest of you to keep himself standing, and comes back if you leave the tomb intact.

blocks.name: Fire Spirit
res: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
blocks.desc: A hand-sized knot of flame that drifts the temple halls looking for something dry. It lights the room, which is the only courtesy it offers.
blocks.tactics: Comes close on purpose so that hitting it costs you.

blocks.name: Sphinx
res: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
blocks.desc: It guards the door and would rather talk than fight, but it will fight. Answer wrong and it does not ask twice.
blocks.tactics: Opens with a question. Fights from the air once the conversation is over.

blocks.name: Cult Priest
blocks.desc: He keeps the fires lit under the Scorched King and believes every word of it. There are a lot of him.
blocks.tactics: Stands at the back, keeps the front rank on its feet, and burns anyone who reaches him.

blocks.name: The Scorched King
blocks.desc: He was something bright once and the desert burned the rest out of him. He still thinks he is doing the right thing.
blocks.tactics: Two blade strikes a turn, then a flare that lights the whole temple and anyone standing in it.

blocks.name: Cutthroat Pirate
blocks.desc: He has been on this beach a long time and the ship is not coming back for him. He wants your boots.
blocks.tactics: Fights in a crowd, aims for whoever is already hurt, and takes to the water when it turns.

blocks.name: Giant Crab
blocks.desc: Shell like a shield wall and two claws that do not let go. It came out of the rock pools for the noise.
blocks.tactics: Grabs and squeezes. The shell is the real problem.

blocks.name: Gull Harpy
blocks.desc: Too big, too loud, and it has your voice off by heart already. It calls in the rest with it.
blocks.tactics: Shouts in a friend's voice from the cliffs, then dives on whoever answers.

blocks.name: Captain Blacktide
blocks.desc: He took the Drowned Bell off a church and has not had a quiet night since. He will give it back for a price.
blocks.tactics: Keeps his crew between you and him, parries the one blow that matters, and fights hardest when cornered.

blocks.name: Drowned Sailor
blocks.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak
blocks.desc: Still in its uniform, still at its post, still full of seawater. It went down with the ship and came back up.
blocks.tactics: Works below decks where the footing is bad and drags you under where it can.

blocks.name: Electric Eel
blocks.desc: It lives in the flooded hold and the water around it makes your teeth ache. Do not stand in the water.
blocks.tactics: Shocks everything standing in the same water as it.

blocks.name: Giant Octopus
blocks.desc: Eight arms through the broken hull, each one working on its own idea. It only needs two of them on you.
blocks.tactics: Grapples two of you at once and pulls them away from the rest.

blocks.name: The Ghost Captain
res: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
blocks.desc: He went down with the ship because he would not leave the wheel, and he is still at it. The wreck follows him around.
blocks.tactics: Fills the hold with cold water nobody can see, frightens the group apart, and takes them one at a time.

blocks.name: Merman Warrior
blocks.desc: He has guarded the reef since long before the bell went into it. You are the trespasser here and he is right about that.
blocks.tactics: Fights from deep water and makes you come to him.

blocks.name: Bull Shark
blocks.desc: It has been circling since you went in. It gets braver the moment anyone starts bleeding.
blocks.tactics: Waits for the first wound, then will not leave that person alone.

blocks.name: Siren
blocks.desc: The singing is not for you, it is about you, and it works. The reef below her is paved with people who swam toward it.
blocks.tactics: Charms the strongest swimmer and lets the water finish the job.

blocks.name: The Sea Serpent
blocks.desc: Long enough to wrap the reef twice and old enough to have seen the temple built. It does not share the water.
blocks.tactics: Coils out of reach, then comes in once with everything.

blocks.name: Abyss Angler
blocks.desc: All you see is the little light. Everything behind the light is mouth.
blocks.tactics: Hangs still in the black with the lure out and takes whoever swims to it.

blocks.name: Sea Witch
blocks.desc: She has been trading with drowning sailors for years and has never once given a fair price. The temple is hers now.
blocks.tactics: Keeps the pillars between you, mends herself, and lets the golem hold the floor.

blocks.name: Coral Golem
blocks.languages: understands its maker's orders but can't speak
res: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
blocks.desc: Grown rather than built, out of live coral and old stone. It is part of the temple and the temple is part of it.
blocks.tactics: Plants itself in the doorway and hardens. Going around it is faster.

blocks.name: The Kraken
blocks.languages: understands Aquan, Deep Speech and Primordial but cannot speak
blocks.desc: It is why the bell was rung, why the bell was sunk, and why the coast is empty. It has been under the temple the entire time.
blocks.tactics: Grapples two at once, drags them down, and brings the roof in on the rest.

blocks.name: Plague Rat
blocks.desc: It carries the thing that emptied the village and is in no danger from it. There are thousands.
blocks.tactics: Comes in numbers across the water and bites once each.

blocks.name: Giant Leech
blocks.desc: Arm-length, boneless, and already attached before you feel it. It gets bigger as the fight goes on.
blocks.tactics: Fastens on and will not let go. Every turn it drinks, it mends.

blocks.name: Bog Man
blocks.desc: Peat and roots in the shape of a man, standing waist deep where it has always stood. It only notices you when you touch the water.
blocks.tactics: Rises out of the fen behind the group and sets itself. Fire is the answer and it knows it.

blocks.name: The Swamp King Croc
blocks.desc: King of the fen by the simple method of eating everything that disagreed. He is mostly log until he is not.
blocks.tactics: Takes one person in his jaws and rolls. Everything else can wait.

blocks.name: Mad Plague Doctor
blocks.desc: He is still making his rounds in a village with nobody left in it. He believes he is helping, which is the worst part.
blocks.tactics: Insists on treating you. The treatment is the attack.

blocks.name: Rotting Villager
blocks.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak
blocks.desc: A villager who did not get out in time and did not stay down either. The smell arrives first.
blocks.tactics: Walks into the middle of you so the stench does the work.

blocks.name: Carrion Crow
blocks.desc: They have had a very good month and are not frightened of people any more. The whole treeline is black with them.
blocks.tactics: Lifts off all at once and goes for eyes.

blocks.name: The Plague Beast
blocks.desc: The curse got into something large and made it its own. It is the shape of the sickness and the reason it spreads.
blocks.tactics: Stands in the open and lets the air around it do half the damage, feeding on whoever drops.

blocks.name: Frog Brute
blocks.desc: Up on two legs, wider than it is tall, and the tongue comes out twenty feet. It eats what it can lift.
blocks.tactics: Tongues the lightest of you across the bog and swallows from there.

blocks.name: Will-o'-Wisp
res: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
blocks.desc: A little light out over the water, exactly where the ground stops being ground. It has been doing this a very long time.
blocks.tactics: Leads you into the deep bog, puts its light out, and waits.

blocks.name: Giant Mosquito
blocks.desc: Big enough to hear coming, which is the only mercy on offer. It drinks and leaves the fever behind.
blocks.tactics: Comes in, drinks, and is out of reach before you turn.

blocks.name: The Bog Troll
blocks.desc: A troll that has been underwater so long things grow on it. The wounds close faster down here.
blocks.tactics: Fights from the water where the footing is yours to lose, and heals between every exchange.

blocks.name: Hag Spawn
blocks.desc: The hag has children and this is one of them. It has her temper and none of her patience.
blocks.tactics: Fights in a pair with its sibling and screams for mother when it is losing.

blocks.name: Root Horror
blocks.desc: The lair has roots that reach further than the tree they came from. They take hold of ankles.
blocks.tactics: Looks exactly like the floor until someone stands on it.

blocks.name: Toxic Slime
blocks.desc: Green, thigh-deep, and working its way slowly across the lair floor. It dissolves what it covers.
blocks.tactics: Oozes onto whoever stands still and splits when you cut it.

blocks.name: The Bog Hag
blocks.desc: She put the rot on the marsh and she can take it off, for a price that is always a person. She will look like someone you trust when you come in.
blocks.tactics: Wears a friendly face until the door shuts, then fights with everything and keeps mending.

blocks.name: Kobold Miner
blocks.desc: It has worked this shaft its whole life and knows every prop that will not hold. That is the whole plan.
blocks.tactics: Fights where the roof is weak and pulls it down on you.

blocks.name: Rock Worm
blocks.desc: It eats the rock and does not much mind what is in the rock. The tunnels down here are all its work.
blocks.tactics: Comes out of a wall nobody was watching.

blocks.name: Cave Bat Swarm
blocks.desc: The whole roof of the shaft moves when the lantern goes near it. Then it comes down.
blocks.tactics: Fills the tunnel and puts out your light.

blocks.name: The Goblin Foreman
blocks.desc: He runs the shift and the shift runs scared. He has the keys to the Great Forge on a chain round his neck.
blocks.tactics: Keeps the miners swinging and stays behind them until there is nobody left to stay behind.

blocks.name: Crystal Golem
blocks.languages: understands its maker's orders but can't speak
blocks.desc: Grown out of the cavern wall and shaped like something that walks. It rings when you hit it and that is about all.
blocks.tactics: Sets itself in the narrow part of the cavern and waits for you to tire.

blocks.name: Basilisk
blocks.desc: Eight legs, bad breath, and a look that turns people into part of the scenery. Half the statues down here were walking last year.
blocks.tactics: Meets your eye on purpose. Fight it looking at the floor.

blocks.name: Gem Spider
blocks.desc: Its back is set with stones worth more than the mine. That is why people come down here, and why they stop.
blocks.tactics: Hangs in the crystal where it cannot be told apart from it.

blocks.name: The Crystal Drake
blocks.desc: Grown in the cavern and made of the same stuff as the walls. Its breath comes out as a sheet of splinters.
blocks.tactics: Shatters the crystal around you, then picks off whoever is bleeding.

blocks.name: Magma Slime
blocks.desc: It comes up through the floor of the tunnel and goes where it likes. Everything it has crossed is still burning.
blocks.tactics: Rolls onto you so standing next to it costs you every turn.

blocks.name: Fire Salamander
blocks.desc: It lives in the lava the way a fish lives in a river and comes out for company. Touching it is a mistake.
blocks.tactics: Closes in and stays close. Cold is the quick way.

blocks.name: Cursed Dwarf
blocks.desc: He was a smith down here before the forge was taken, and something in the heat got into him. He still thinks he is at work.
blocks.tactics: Hammers whoever is nearest and does not register that he is losing.

blocks.name: The Lava Golem
blocks.languages: understands its maker's orders but can't speak
blocks.desc: Someone poured the forge into a mold and it got up. It leaves its own footprints burned into the rock.
blocks.tactics: Walks into the middle of the party and stands there glowing.

blocks.name: Clockwork Soldier
blocks.languages: understands its maker's orders but can't speak
blocks.desc: Wound up a hundred years ago and still at its post. It does not tire, bleed, or ask who you are.
blocks.tactics: Fights exactly the same way every round, which is its one weakness.

blocks.name: Forge Hound
blocks.languages: understands its maker's orders but can't speak
blocks.desc: Built to keep thieves out of the Great Forge and never told the forge had been stolen. Red hot all the way through.
blocks.tactics: Runs down whoever tries to leave the forge floor.

blocks.name: Furnace Imp
blocks.desc: It works the bellows and enjoys it far too much. It throws what is in the fire at you.
blocks.tactics: Stays by the furnace, pelts you with whatever is glowing, and never lands.

blocks.name: The Iron Golem
blocks.languages: understands its maker's orders but can't speak
imm: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine
blocks.desc: The Great Forge did not make it. The Great Forge is inside it. Whoever ordered that has not been seen since.
blocks.tactics: Takes the whole party's best round without flinching, and then begins.

blocks.name: Undead Gravedigger
blocks.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak
blocks.desc: He dug every grave in this yard, including the last one, and he is still working. He does not like the holes standing empty.
blocks.tactics: Swings the spade and keeps backing toward the open grave he wants you in.

blocks.name: Ghoul Hound
blocks.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak
blocks.desc: Something that was a dog, kept on well past the point it should have been let go. It smells graves from a mile out.
blocks.tactics: Runs in a pack and brings people down to be fed on.

blocks.name: Banshee
res: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
blocks.desc: She died in the abbey the night the bells stopped and has been telling everyone about it since. The scream is the dangerous part.
blocks.tactics: Screams once at the whole group, then drains whoever stayed.

blocks.name: The Headless Knight
blocks.desc: He is looking for his head and is reasonably sure one of yours will do. He does not need eyes to find you.
blocks.tactics: Guards against the first blow, then swings twice and once more harder.

blocks.name: Ghost Monk
res: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
blocks.desc: He kept the hours before and keeps them now, and you are standing in the cloister during prayers. He would rather you left.
blocks.tactics: Fights only as long as you are in the cloister. Mends himself and the others first.

blocks.name: Cloister Gargoyle
res: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine
blocks.desc: Half the size of the ones on the roof and twice as quick. There are a great many of them along the cloister wall.
blocks.tactics: Sits in the stonework in a row, and all of them come off at once.

blocks.name: Poltergeist
res: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
blocks.desc: You cannot see it and it can lift a pew. Everything in the cloister is its weapon.
blocks.tactics: Throws the furniture from across the room and never comes close.

blocks.name: The Cursed Abbot
blocks.desc: He silenced the bells himself and has a long explanation ready. He is sure the abbey is better this way.
blocks.tactics: Keeps his congregation standing, mends constantly, and will not be turned.

blocks.name: Bone Walker
blocks.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak
blocks.desc: Built out of whatever the catacombs had spare, which was a lot. It has more arms than it strictly needs.
blocks.tactics: Sets itself in the narrow passage so only one of you can reach it.

blocks.name: Crypt Rat King
blocks.desc: One rat the size of a hound and several hundred that are not. The big one decides where they all go.
blocks.tactics: Pours along the bone shelves and drops on you from both sides.

blocks.name: Barrow Wight
blocks.desc: Buried with his sword and his rings, and he still has strong feelings about both. Anyone he kills gets up again on his side.
blocks.tactics: Drains the toughest of you to raise them, and avoids the stairs up to daylight.

blocks.name: The Bone Dragon
blocks.desc: The abbey was built on top of it, and the catacombs are just the parts of it they dug around. There is no flesh left and no less of it.
blocks.tactics: Fills the catacomb with grave air, then bites twice from the dark.

blocks.name: Shadow Priest
blocks.desc: He serves the thing in the bell tower and runs its errands gladly. There is nothing left to bargain with.
blocks.tactics: Hides behind the knight, keeps it upright, and throws the dark at whoever gets past.

blocks.name: Vampire Bat
blocks.desc: It roosts in the bell and drinks what the tower leaves it. Dog-sized, and it has had plenty.
blocks.tactics: Dives, drinks, and climbs out of reach to swallow.

blocks.name: Death Knight
blocks.desc: The best of the abbey's guard, kept on past death and fully aware of it. He is not sorry.
blocks.tactics: Shields the first attack, then two blows and a third that drains.

blocks.name: The Lich
res: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
blocks.desc: It stopped the bells because the bells were the one thing that could reach it. Everything else in the abbey is its work.
blocks.tactics: Never comes within reach if it can help it, and comes back in a week if you leave its anchor in the tower.

blocks.name: Thorn Archer
blocks.desc: She has held this treeline for three hundred years and the thorn has gotten into her. She will not ask you to leave twice.
blocks.tactics: Shoots from cover at long range and moves after every shot.

blocks.name: Shadow Stag
blocks.desc: A stag the color of a shadow with a rack like a hedge of spears. It is not a deer any more.
blocks.tactics: Charges out of the trees, then away, and comes back around.

blocks.name: Wicked Pixie
blocks.desc: Hand-sized, delighted with itself, and entirely out of patience with people. The wood has turned it cruel.
blocks.tactics: Flits in, jabs, and is twenty feet up before you look.

blocks.name: The Briar Bear
blocks.desc: A bear the briar grew through and kept. The thorns are part of it now and they come away in you.
blocks.tactics: Sets its feet and makes you come into the thorns to reach it.

blocks.name: Corrupted Dryad
blocks.desc: Her tree is sick and she has decided it is your fault. She may even be right.
blocks.tactics: Talks first, charms whoever listens, and sets the wood on the rest.

blocks.name: Werewolf
res: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered
blocks.desc: Perfectly reasonable for most of the month. This is not most of the month.
blocks.tactics: Fights as a wolf, and ordinary steel barely troubles it.

blocks.name: Fungal Brute
blocks.desc: Grown up out of the glade floor overnight, shoulder-high and shaped roughly like a man. The spores are the problem.
blocks.tactics: Stands in the middle of you and bursts when it drops.

blocks.name: The Dark Unicorn
blocks.desc: It was the glade's guardian and the thorn got into it too. It is still beautiful, which makes it worse.
blocks.tactics: Charges, and mends itself out of whatever it has just run through.

blocks.name: Thorn Knight
blocks.desc: Armored in bark that grew to fit and will not come off. He holds the old city gate out of habit.
blocks.tactics: Parries properly, waits for your mistake, and punishes it once.

blocks.name: Thorn Mage
blocks.desc: She has been studying the thorn for a century and has stopped being able to tell her work from herself.
blocks.tactics: Grows cover between you and her, keeps the knights up, and never closes.

blocks.name: Owlbear
blocks.desc: Owl at the top, bear underneath, foul temper throughout. It has been living in the ruins since the elves left.
blocks.tactics: One target at a time, and it moves on to the next the moment the first goes down.

blocks.name: The Thorn General
blocks.desc: He gave the order that let the thorn in and has spent the years since insisting it was correct. The city agrees with him now.
blocks.tactics: Keeps you at ten feet, guards the one blow that would land, and answers with three.

blocks.name: Thorn Beast
blocks.desc: The briar made something that walks. It is all thorn and no thought.
blocks.tactics: Reaches fifteen feet and drags people into the bank of thorns.

blocks.name: Vine Serpent
blocks.desc: It hangs with the other vines until one of them moves. Then it is around your chest.
blocks.tactics: Grabs one person and squeezes, ignoring everything else.

blocks.name: Heartwood Golem
blocks.desc: The Heart Tree put out a limb and the limb got up. It is built of the oldest wood in the wood.
blocks.tactics: Blocks the way to the tree and heals as long as the tree stands.

blocks.name: The Thorn Queen
blocks.desc: She is the thorn, and the Thorned Heart is her. She has been waiting under the tree for someone to come and argue about it.
blocks.tactics: Charms one of you to fight for her, and the Heart Tree mends her every turn it is still standing.

blocks.name: Storm Harpy
blocks.desc: It nests under the cloud bridges and sings at whoever is crossing. The storm covers the noise of the rest of them.
blocks.tactics: Sings from below the bridge and takes whoever leans over.

blocks.name: Cloud Ogre
blocks.desc: Not a proper cloud giant, just big and bad-tempered and up very high. It throws what it is standing on.
blocks.tactics: Hurls lumps of cloudstuff, then wades in.

blocks.name: Wind Spirit
res: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
blocks.desc: You cannot see it, only what it is doing to the bridge ropes. It wants you over the edge, not dead.
blocks.tactics: Shoves rather than strikes, and the fall does the rest.

blocks.name: The Griffon King
blocks.desc: Eagle in front, lion behind, and king of everything that flies between the bridges. The nests up here are all his family.
blocks.tactics: Never lands. Takes one of you off the bridge and drops them.

blocks.name: Sky Serpent
blocks.desc: It swims through the air between the gardens and is longer than the bridge. Mostly it is left alone.
blocks.tactics: Circles the garden out of reach and comes through it once, lengthwise.

blocks.name: Thunderbird
blocks.desc: The storm follows it rather than the other way round. Every beat of the wings cracks.
blocks.tactics: Dives through the group trailing lightning and climbs out.

blocks.name: Stone Sentinel
blocks.languages: understands its maker's orders but can't speak
blocks.desc: One of the statues along the garden path, and nobody has counted them lately. It steps down when you pass.
blocks.tactics: Waits for the group to spread out along the path, then blocks the middle.

blocks.name: The Storm Drake
blocks.desc: It keeps the gardens and the weather over them and takes lightning as a compliment. The Storm Titan's own beast.
blocks.tactics: Hovers, empties its lungs down the length of the garden, and feeds on anyone who answers with lightning.

blocks.name: Storm Soldier
blocks.desc: He has stood this wall long enough that the storm has got into the armor. The pike carries it.
blocks.tactics: Holds the line at ten feet and will not break formation.

blocks.name: Air Elemental
res: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
blocks.desc: A piece of the storm with a shape to it, pulled in to walk the walls. It is the wall's weather now.
blocks.tactics: Picks a target up off the parapet and takes them over the side.

blocks.name: Cloud Djinn
res: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
blocks.desc: Bound to the fortress by an old bargain and deeply tired of it. It fights well anyway.
blocks.tactics: Mends itself on the way in and fights in the air where you cannot follow.

blocks.name: The Storm Giant
blocks.desc: He holds the wall for the Titan and does it properly. Lightning is weather to him, nothing more.
blocks.tactics: Two swings and a third that takes the parapet with it. Lightning only makes him stronger.

blocks.name: Thunder Knight
blocks.desc: Last rank before the throne, and the best of them. Every blow lands twice, once as the hit and once as the noise.
blocks.tactics: Shields the first attack and then brings the maul down with the thunder behind it.

blocks.name: Storm Wraith
res: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
blocks.desc: Someone who went off the fortress wall and never finished falling. It is part of the storm now.
blocks.tactics: Comes through the throne room wall, frightens the group apart, and drains the stragglers.

blocks.name: Roc
blocks.desc: Big enough that its shadow is the first warning and the second is already too late. It nests above the throne.
blocks.tactics: Takes one person in each foot and climbs.

blocks.name: The Storm Titan
blocks.desc: He sat down on the Storm Throne and the weather has done what he says ever since. He has been expecting you for some time.
blocks.tactics: Keeps you at fifteen feet, and when you bunch up he calls the whole storm down on the floor.

blocks.name: Hellhound
blocks.desc: It hunts the ash wastes in threes and the ash does not slow it. The bite comes out the other side still burning.
blocks.tactics: Runs the group down and cuts off whoever falls behind.

blocks.name: Fire Imp
blocks.desc: One of a great many, and the only reason it is dangerous is that there is never one. It is on fire and pleased about it.
blocks.tactics: Swarms in the air and keeps out of reach of anything slow.

blocks.name: Ash Ghoul
blocks.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak
blocks.desc: It lies down in the ash until something walks past. Everything out here is the same gray.
blocks.tactics: Rises underfoot in a group and pins one person to feed.

blocks.name: Cerberus
blocks.desc: Three heads, one very poor temper, and the job of keeping things in rather than out. You are going the wrong way.
blocks.tactics: Bites with all three and cannot be flanked or surprised.

blocks.name: Chain Demon
blocks.desc: Wrapped in the chains it used to be in charge of. It fights at the length of them.
blocks.tactics: Hooks someone at fifteen feet and drags them off alone.

blocks.name: Shadow Fiend
blocks.desc: It will be whoever you would rather be fighting, right up until it is not. The halls are full of people it convinced.
blocks.tactics: Wears a friendly face, turns one of you, and drains them when they are no longer useful.

blocks.name: Demon Jailer
blocks.desc: It has kept these halls locked for longer than the halls have existed. It is not interested in why you came.
blocks.tactics: Shuts the door behind you and sets itself in front of it.

blocks.name: The Pit Warden
blocks.desc: Whatever is in the deepest of these cells, the Warden is what keeps it there. That ought to tell you something.
blocks.tactics: Takes the whole party's first round, hardens, and then starts swinging.

blocks.name: Lava Serpent
blocks.desc: It swims the lake the way an eel swims a river, and the lake is fire. It surfaces for air it does not need.
blocks.tactics: Comes out of the lake at whoever is nearest the shore.

blocks.name: Fire Giant
blocks.desc: He forges on the shore of the lake and has made most of what the Abyss fights with. The hammer is also the sword.
blocks.tactics: Plants himself and swings. Fire is not going to help you.

blocks.name: Dark Phoenix
blocks.desc: It burns black instead of gold and comes back anyway. Killing it is the start of the problem.
blocks.tactics: Fights in the air, and when it drops it takes the ground around it with it.

blocks.name: The Flame Fiend
blocks.desc: It is the biggest thing on the lake shore and the fire comes off it in sheets. The Demon King keeps it as a doorman.
blocks.tactics: Holds you at fifteen feet with the lash and burns anyone who closes.

blocks.name: Demon Knight
blocks.desc: Last rank before the throne, in armor made on the lake shore. It has never been asked to retreat.
blocks.tactics: Shields the first blow, then two of its own and a third with everything behind it.

blocks.name: Abyss Horror
blocks.desc: Nobody built this and nobody summoned it. It was here before the throne and does not acknowledge it.
blocks.tactics: Grapples two of you at fifteen feet and pulls them into the dark.

blocks.name: Demon Sorcerer
blocks.desc: It does the King's reading for him and has its own ideas about the throne. Not yet, though.
blocks.tactics: Stays at the back of the hall, keeps the knights standing, and burns whoever gets through.

blocks.name: The Demon King
blocks.desc: Everything in the other nine worlds was working for him, whether it knew it or not. He is the last thing in the book and he is sitting down.
blocks.tactics: Guards, then three strikes a turn, and he does not stand up until the second half of the fight.
